name: Unregistered adviser offering to handle client funds
description: An entity offers to trade or hold funds on the recipient's behalf without disclosing SEBI registration — illegal advisory conduct.

source_references.quote: Investment Advisers have to limit themselves to giving advice and they should not handle cash or securities.

explanation.plain: Someone offered to trade or hold your money for you as an 'expert'. SEBI-registered advisers may only advise — they must never handle your funds. Check their registration.
explanation.technical: TRADING_ON_BEHALF_OF_CLIENT (financial-claim) with an investment solicitation. SEBI: advisers must not handle client cash or securities; acting unregistered is illegal.
verification_steps: Ask for and verify the SEBI registration number.
Never hand your funds to an 'expert' to trade for you.
